enumeration.scope: RPC-enumerated references; completeness of all chain activity is not independently proven.

limitations: Representation correspondence does not prove execution order, replay boundary, receipt/trace availability, state equivalence, authorization or cryptographic hash equivalence.
Reported transactionIndex and list ordinal remain separate observations; every replay boundary is unknown.
Each response is classified independently. Different captures may expose different views for the same provider and block hash.
Unknown system targets and unsupported execution remain reference rows; no ordinary-only denominator replaces all enumerated EVM actions.
Unknown or incomplete ordinary envelopes remain unresolved; supported envelope validation does not establish broad transaction-type coverage.
An empty system list requires a block-hash request because no returned envelope can bind a number-only empty response to the selected hash.
Finality, parent continuity, authenticated provenance, query/execution validation, budgets and output sealing remain required outside this pure normalizer.
